notes: Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) succeeded for all pages; no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://www.cb2.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovered via the site's own primary nav (Decor & Mirrors flyout links to /holiday/halloween/1) plus the /holiday/ hub page's own 'shop by category' subway carousel, which lists every holiday CB2 currently sells: Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Hanukkah, New Year's Eve, Easter, Valentine's Day (site visited 2026-09-03, so Christmas/Hanukkah/NYE/Easter/Valentine inventory is thin pre-season - counts are genuinely low, not a scraping error). /holiday/ itself (528 results) is a generic multi-holiday hub mixing all of the above under one PLP - kept as a MANUAL REVIEW grouping row per instructions rather than assigning it a single holiday. Christmas has its own 4 real sub-categories (Decorations/Ornaments/Stockings & Tree Skirts/Dinnerware & Entertaining) reached from /holiday/christmas/'s subway carousel; kept Christmas as a grouping row (children are subsets) rather than double-counting its own 238-item view-all total. The other holidays (Halloween/Thanksgiving/Hanukkah/NYE/Easter/Valentine's) are flat leaf categories - each checked for its own subway carousel and none had holiday-specific children beyond a generic 'Gifts' link. Excluded as non-category/non-seasonal: /holiday/shop-gifts/ and Christmas's 'Gifts' link (both redirect to the general /gifts/ page, not holiday-specific), 'Best Sellers: Holiday' (/holiday/best-selling-holiday/1, a cross-holiday curated bestseller bucket, NEVER-EXTRACT Best Sellers rule), 'Gift Cards' (not a product category), 'How To Host A Holiday Dinner Party' (editorial), 'Modern Thanksgiving with Romilly Newman' (designer-collab listing, excluded under the brand/designer-page rule), and 'Fireplace Accessories' linked from the Christmas carousel - its canonical URL redirects to the plain, non-holiday /accessories/fireplace-accessories/1 (same page as the regular Decor & Mirrors nav item), so it is not a genuine Christmas-specific category. View All Christmas (/holiday/all-christmas/1) canonicalizes to the same URL as Christmas itself (/holiday/christmas/, identical 238 count) - kept once per the overlap rule. All qty values are the site's own data-num-results attribute on each canonical PLP.
